There are too many types of fish for them to be able to take care of them properly. I only know freshwater fish and turtles, and they mistreat both. Bettas in cups, plecos sharing tanks, and oh dear the turtles 😪 They have 2 female yellow belly sliders in the shop with barely 5 gals of water between them. You can tell theyve been in those tanks for years, with filthy water and not nearly enough filtration. I can tell at least 1 has a lot of retained scutes and the other can't even bask properly. These are huge turtles, at least 6in each. The rule is 10gal of water for every inch of shell. Its extremely sad...if you cant take care of the animal, dont have it in your store. My turtle is only 5 inches and he has 75 gallons of water. Since this is a local business i understand constraints, but maybe reduce the number of species and you can have healthier animals.  Better than petco because its local, but i dread the future for those poor turtles. And those territorial plecos that keep taking nips out of each other

I’m incredibly grateful to Aquario Piscis for saving my fish during a tank crisis. Within two hours, I lost half my fish and felt hopeless, but they treated them for four days and saved many. Their care and expertise made all the difference.

To those leaving negative comments:

The smell? It’s a pet store with live animals—would you prefer harmful fragrances?

Small tanks? They’re temporary for fish on sale, allowing variety while ensuring proper treatment before purchase.

Complaining about care? Let’s see your tanks, sizes, and fish care skills.

Thank you, Aquario Piscis, for your hard work and dedication. You’ve earned my trust!

And to show my gratitude for saving my fish I made this Aerial Video for the store! Thank you so much for the kindness and help you offered me.
